status: PROTOCOL + EXPECTED SIGNATURE. No shots in this file.

echo_check.pass_band: peak within 5% of 0.486254 on a calibration tile
echo_check.role: device is an instrument only if it first reads its own line
echo_check.prior_first-principles_job_not_this_fami: ibm_kingston d95c8revtlqs73fv8es0 measured 0.4883 vs 0.486254 (0.43%). That is the first-principles Walsh interference echo lock, not the payment-graph S(ω) family.

exact_map.fov_note: Binding constraint is 75×76 µm FOV + Rb C6, not the 256-atom budget. Packing 252 atoms destroys the exact map.

aquila.payment_encoding: Native pairs realize H = κ D − A. Extra payment-graph edges that do not fit the exact pair geometry are local detunings on the corresponding atoms (transaction shock), not extra packed atoms.
aquila.readout: atom-resolved populations over a 4 µs analog window → L(t) → S(ω)

expected_signature.native_cell: pair gap δ = 0.839229 in the analog spectrum
expected_signature.aml_ring_detuning: excess low-ω weight vs null-detuning interleaves
expected_signature.null_control: zero extra detuning, same geometry, same shot budget

aquila.prior_256_atom_jobs: Eight earlier Aquila jobs (99.3% loading) encoded classical fraud features as detunings for an ML feature map. That is not this protocol and is not cited as S(ω) evidence.
